title: Oh, the misery, everybody wants to be my enemy!

themes.description: Oh, the misery, everybody wants to be my enemy!

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 7 champion buffs, 5 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Oh, the misery, everybody wants to be my enemy! Structured changes across 17 entities this patch.

champions.name: Akali
champions.tldr: Base damage increased to 35–182 from 29–15.; AP ratio increased to 55% AP from 40% AP.
champions.gameplayImpact: Akali is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Base damage
lines.note: Base damage increased to 35–182 from 29–15.

lines.label: AP ratio
lines.note: AP ratio increased to 55% AP from 40% AP.

champions.name: Graves
champions.tldr: Critical strike bonus pellet damage reduced to 20% from 30%.; Crit attacks where all pellets hit now deal 59.98% of the basic attacks where all pellets hit, reduced from 73.33%.
champions.gameplayImpact: Graves loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Reduction to the bonus critical damage (now 66.%) is stronger than the base crit damage change (now 81.8%) due to having the same factor but different influence on the final damage.
